record.scope: Timor-Leste entry restrictions at the Indonesian land frontier; first-day operational observation specifically at Motaain–Batugade.

record.context: Later regime allowed Monday/Wednesday crossing before daily reopening March 21 2022.
record.uncertainty: First-day implementation on 19 March 2020 is directly evidenced at Motaain–Batugade; broader emergency restrictions were subsequently enacted. The 21 March 2022 endpoint restores daily conditional Timorese admission; Indonesian rules and Oecusse transit approvals differed.
